items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All three callers (finalize_iterate.py, finalize_security_compliance.py, compliance_runner.py) now parse generator_errors from update_compliance.py's stdout JSON on non-zero exit and surface it, with stderr fallback preserved for other failure classes.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: New helpers never raise: JSON parse failures are caught (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError) and fall back to stderr.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input, SQL, HTML, or secrets involved.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Each site has a red-then-green test asserting the surfaced diagnostic string (outcome), plus a companion test pinning the non-JSON-stdout stderr fallback.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No loops or queries added; single json.loads on an already-captured string.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Consistent per-site helper naming (_generator_error_detail / _compliance_failure_detail); no file approaches the 300-line cap.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer (update_compliance.py stdout JSON) to consumer (each of the 3 callers) is exactly the boundary fixed; new tests feed real JSON payloads through the parse path end to end.
